careersPage.title: Senior work. No hand-offs.
careersPage.subtitle: We're a small team that does the work ourselves — no account managers, no layers between you and the client, no bench. If that sounds like less structure, it's because it is. It's also more ownership than most places offer.
careersPage.value1Desc: You own outcomes, not tasks handed down from someone else.
careersPage.value2Desc: Everyone here does real client work. There's no junior tier.
careersPage.value3Desc: You ship things clients actually run, not slides about them.
careersPage.value4Desc: You'll handle real client data and real responsibility from day one.
careersPage.teamNote: Flavian, Inna, Aslan, Emil and Paul do the work you'd be joining.
careersPage.noPositionsDesc: We're small and we hire rarely, but deliberately. If you'd rather build real things than sit in meetings about them, we'd like to hear from you anyway.
careersPage.ctaDesc: We're a five-person team — email goes straight to Flavian.
